name: @tychenjiajun/pi-voice
description: Speech-to-text for the Pi coding agent: press a shortcut and dictate — transcripts land directly in your chat. Local models (Whisper, Parakeet) or any OpenAI-compatible remote ASR endpoint, with compaction-style post-processing that strips fillers.
